reviews.title: Good for freshers, limited growth later
reviews.pros: Excellent training programs for freshers. Work-life balance is generally good with predictable hours. Brand name helps in career.
reviews.cons: Salary hikes are very low, around 5-7% annually. Onsite opportunities have reduced significantly. Too much bureaucracy in decision making.

reviews.title: Stable but stagnant
reviews.pros: Job security is excellent, rarely any layoffs. Good health insurance and leave policies. Campus facilities are world-class.
reviews.cons: Career growth is very slow, promotions take 3-4 years minimum. Technology stack is often outdated. Middle management is inefficient.

reviews.title: Great brand, decent workplace
reviews.pros: Strong brand recognition opens doors globally. Internal job postings allow role changes. Diversity and inclusion are taken seriously.
reviews.cons: Client-dependent work can be monotonous. Variable pay is hard to achieve fully. Internal politics at senior levels.

reviews.title: Average experience overall
reviews.pros: Mysore campus is beautiful with great amenities. Work from home flexibility post-COVID. Good for people who want stability.
reviews.cons: Testing roles are undervalued compared to development. Salary is below market rate for experienced professionals. Limited exposure to modern testing frameworks.

reviews.title: Best place to start career
reviews.pros: Infosys Foundation Program is one of the best training programs in the industry. You get exposure to enterprise-level projects early. Colleagues are helpful and collaborative.
reviews.cons: Initial salary is quite low compared to product companies. Bench period can be frustrating with no meaningful work. Relocation happens frequently without much choice.

reviews.title: Job security is unmatched
reviews.pros: Tata group brand gives immense job security. Work-life balance is better than most IT companies. Great for people who value stability over rapid growth.
reviews.cons: Salary increments are the lowest in the industry at 4-6%. Technology choices are limited by client requirements. Appraisal system feels unfair and opaque.

reviews.title: Not for ambitious people
reviews.pros: Good work-life balance in most projects. Decent health benefits and insurance coverage. TCS iON learning platform has useful courses.
reviews.cons: Extremely low salary compared to market standards. No recognition for hard work, promotions are time-based not merit-based. Bond period of 2 years traps freshers.

reviews.title: Massive scale with global exposure
reviews.pros: Opportunity to work with Fortune 500 clients globally. Internal mobility program (ILP) is well-structured. TCS has one of the best training ecosystems.
reviews.cons: Getting into good projects depends heavily on luck. Bench period anxiety is real. Manager quality varies wildly across teams.

reviews.title: Decent first job experience
reviews.pros: Campus is well-maintained with good cafeteria. Team leads are generally supportive of freshers. Flexible work-from-home policy.
reviews.cons: Pay is significantly below what startups offer. Getting into digital or cloud projects is very competitive. Annual bonus is negligible.

reviews.title: Okay for beginners, not long term
reviews.pros: Brand name of Wipro helps in getting interviews elsewhere. Work-life balance depends on the project but is generally manageable. Good diversity and women-friendly policies.
reviews.cons: One of the lowest paying IT companies in India. Appraisal cycle is inconsistent and disappointing. Frequent layoffs have hurt employee morale recently.

reviews.title: Improving culture under new leadership
reviews.pros: New CEO has brought positive changes in technology adoption. Cloud and AI practices are growing rapidly. Internal hackathons and innovation challenges are fun.
reviews.cons: Legacy accounts still dominate the revenue. Salary corrections happen rarely. Office infrastructure could be better in some locations.

reviews.title: Stable but uninspiring
reviews.pros: Good job security if you perform decently. Health insurance coverage is comprehensive. Flexible timings in most projects.
reviews.cons: Promotions are extremely slow and political. Salary gap between freshers and experienced hires is minimal. Client-facing roles have high stress.

reviews.title: Good training, poor retention
reviews.pros: Wipro TalentNext training is comprehensive for freshers. Exposure to multiple domains in the first year. Supportive HR team.
reviews.cons: Retention bonus structure is confusing. No clear career roadmap. High attrition means constant team changes.

reviews.title: High pay, high pressure
reviews.pros: Compensation is among the best in India, including ESOPs. Engineering culture is strong with focus on scale and performance. Smart colleagues push you to grow.
reviews.cons: Work-life balance is poor during sale events like Big Billion Days. On-call rotations can be brutal. Recent Walmart integration has added bureaucracy.

reviews.title: Best for engineers who want scale
reviews.pros: Working on systems that handle millions of requests per second. ESOPs have great value especially post-Walmart acquisition. Tech stack is modern - Kubernetes, microservices, event-driven architecture.
reviews.cons: Promotions to principal engineer level are extremely competitive. Work hours regularly exceed 50+ per week. Management layers have increased post-Walmart.

reviews.title: Good compensation, average culture
reviews.pros: Product managers get significant ownership and autonomy. Data-driven decision making culture. Compensation including ESOPs is very competitive.
reviews.cons: Cross-team collaboration can be challenging. Frequent org restructuring creates uncertainty. Work-life balance suffers during peak seasons.

reviews.title: Not what it used to be
reviews.pros: Good brand on resume. Free food and well-stocked pantry. Smart people across the organization.
reviews.cons: Startup culture is fading, feels more corporate now. Layoffs have happened multiple times creating fear. Growth for non-tech roles is limited.

reviews.title: Great for young professionals

reviews.cons: Job security concerns due to periodic cost-cutting. Processes are still maturing and can be chaotic. Pressure to deliver is intense.

reviews.title: Too much uncertainty

reviews.cons: Multiple rounds of layoffs have destroyed trust. Operations roles are undervalued compared to tech. Frequent restructuring means your role can change without notice.

reviews.title: Innovation hub but chaotic

reviews.pros: Working on India's payment infrastructure is deeply satisfying. Engineering practices are top-notch with strong code review culture. Compensation including ESOPs is very competitive.
reviews.cons: Work hours are long, especially around RBI compliance deadlines. Rapid growth means processes change frequently. Some teams are understaffed leading to burnout.

reviews.title: Great tech, demanding work
reviews.pros: Modern tech stack with React, TypeScript, and micro-frontends. Strong mentorship from senior engineers. Flat hierarchy means your voice is heard.
reviews.cons: On-call can be stressful given payment systems are mission-critical. Growth has slowed meaning fewer new exciting projects. Recent profitability push has increased pressure.

reviews.title: Startup vibes fading
reviews.pros: Product managers get real ownership and P&L responsibility. Fintech domain expertise is highly valued in the market. Good perks and office culture.
reviews.cons: Decision making has become slower with more layers of approval. ESOPs value is uncertain given delayed IPO. Work-life balance depends entirely on your team.

reviews.title: High growth trajectory
reviews.pros: Infrastructure challenges at massive scale with 99.99% uptime requirements. Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native practices. Good learning budget and conference attendance support.
reviews.cons: Incidents can disrupt weekends and holidays. Documentation could be more thorough. Compensation for DevOps roles lags behind SDE roles.

reviews.cons: Sales targets are ruthlessly aggressive. Work hours extend well beyond 9-6, especially at branch level. Saturdays are working days in many branches.

reviews.title: Technology team is underrated
reviews.pros: Digital banking initiatives are genuinely innovative. Job security in banking sector is excellent. Salary for tech roles is competitive with IT companies.
reviews.cons: Legacy systems still power core banking and are painful to work with. Change management processes are extremely slow. Regulatory compliance adds friction to every project.

reviews.title: Avoid branch banking roles
reviews.pros: Strong career progression path if you survive the pressure. Comprehensive banking knowledge across all products. Good retirement benefits and pension schemes.
reviews.cons: Extreme pressure to meet cross-selling targets. Mental health suffers with constant audits and compliance checks. Transfer policy disrupts personal life frequently.

reviews.title: Good for risk and compliance roles
reviews.pros: Exposure to complex financial risk models. Excellent training programs for banking professionals. Job stability is unmatched in the private sector.
reviews.cons: Work-life balance is average at best. Bureaucratic decision-making processes. Limited exposure to modern tech like AI/ML in risk.

reviews.cons: Long working hours including weekends. Target pressure is very high. Transfers across cities happen frequently.

reviews.title: Good pay, demanding expectations
reviews.pros: Jio Platforms works on cutting-edge 5G and AI. Salary packages are among the best for the experience level. Access to global technology partnerships.
reviews.cons: Ambani-driven culture means everything is top priority. Work-life balance suffers during product launches. Internal politics at senior levels.

reviews.title: Not for everyone

reviews.cons: Salary is still below product companies by a wide margin. Appraisal process lacks transparency. Variable pay is almost never paid in full.

reviews.title: Product engineering is the future here
reviews.pros: HCL Products division works on genuinely interesting software. Transition from services to products creates unique career opportunities. International projects offer global exposure.
reviews.cons: Services division still feels like a body shop. Politics increases significantly at lead level and above. Benefits have not kept pace with competitors.

reviews.title: Decent for mid-career professionals
reviews.pros: PM roles get real authority and client interaction. Training opportunities through HCL Academy are good. Stable company with consistent revenue growth.

reviews.title: Avoid if you want rapid growth
